## Endpoints

### Data Read (4)
- `GET /{id}` — Get details for a specific Otter resource by ID.
- `GET /$discovery/rest` — Discover available REST APIs.
- `GET /discovery/v1/apis/drive/v3/rest` — Discover the Drive API v3 REST endpoint.
- `GET /forward/api/v1/team/apps` — Retrieve a list of installed apps for a team.

### Data Write (7)
- `POST /{id}` — Update or modify an Otter resource by ID.
- `POST /api/v3/data/` — Create or update data within the Otter system.
- `POST /monitoring/metrics/add/bulk/v2` — Send bulk widget metrics to Otter monitoring.
- `POST /monitoring/metrics/event3/bulk` — Send bulk event metrics to Otter monitoring.
- `POST /monitoring/metrics/widget/init/v3` — Initialize widget metrics monitoring.
- `POST /v1/{v1Id}` — Update an Otter resource using its V1 ID.
- `POST /v1/site/{siteId}/batch` — Perform a batch update of data for a specific site.

### Config (1)
- `GET /sdk/1/environments/_NLHDsudcHlp/config` — Fetch configuration settings for a specific environment.

### Core API (1)
- `POST /widget_bootstrap/ping/v2` — Ping the widget bootstrap service.

## Quick Start

Here are a few examples to get you started with the Otter API:

```typescript
// Fetch configuration settings for a specific environment.
async function getEnvironmentConfig(environmentId: string) {
  try {
    const config = await client.sdk.environments._NLHDsudcHlp.config.get();
    console.log("Environment Config:", config);
    return config;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching environment config:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Update an Otter resource by ID.
async function updateOtterResource(id: string, data: any) {
  try {
    const response = await client[id].post(data);
    console.log("Update Response:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error updating Otter resource:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Send bulk widget metrics to Otter monitoring.
async function sendWidgetMetrics(metrics: any[]) {
  try {
    const response = await client.monitoring.metrics.add.bulk.v2.post(metrics);
    console.log("Metrics submission response:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error sending widget metrics:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Otter's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Otter data without official API access
- Automate actions on otter.ai (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Otter frontend uses

import { OtterClient } from "./scripts/api.ts";

// Load captured auth from auth.json
